description: Trains one word-level Markov chain per intent from example utterances and picks the intent whose chain yields the lowest perplexity; confidence is derived from perplexity. Trains in milliseconds with no GPU.
model: order-2 word-level Markov chains, Kneser-Ney smoothing with backoff
notes: Single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate; the per-plugin config pins the documented model parameters (n-gram order, smoothing, backoff, stemming, char fallback) and confidence thresholds.
